stocks.description: Stock master data and company information for market analysis
stocks.usage_notes: Core reference table for all stock-related queries and analysis. Contains fundamental company data.

columns.name: symbol
columns.desc: Stock ticker symbol (primary key) - e.g. 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'GOOGL'

columns.name: company_name
columns.desc: Full company name for display and analysis

columns.name: sector
columns.desc: Industry sector (Technology, Healthcare, Finance, etc.) - used for sector analysis and diversification

columns.name: industry
columns.desc: Specific industry within sector - e.g. 'Software', 'Semiconductors', 'Biotechnology'

columns.name: market_cap
columns.desc: Market capitalization in billions - used for size classification (Large/Mid/Small cap)

columns.name: ipo_date
columns.desc: Initial public offering date for historical analysis and company age calculation

columns.name: headquarters_city
columns.desc: Company headquarters location for geographic analysis

columns.name: employee_count
columns.desc: Number of employees - useful for company size analysis

business_rules: Each symbol is unique and serves as the primary key
Sector classification follows standard GICS methodology
Market cap updated daily based on closing price and outstanding shares
common_queries: Get tech stocks: SELECT * FROM stocks WHERE sector = 'Technology'
Large cap stocks: SELECT * FROM stocks WHERE market_cap > 100000000000
Market cap leaders: SELECT TOP 10 * FROM stocks ORDER BY market_cap DESC
Sector breakdown: SELECT sector, COUNT(*) as stock_count, AVG(market_cap) as_avg_cap FROM stocks GROUP BY sector

stock_prices.description: Historical and current stock price data for performance analysis and technical indicators
stock_prices.usage_notes: Use date range filtering for time series analysis, performance calculations, and technical analysis. Contains OHLC daily data.

columns.name: symbol
columns.desc: Stock ticker symbol (foreign key references stocks.symbol)

columns.name: price_date
columns.desc: Date of the price data - primary time dimension for analysis

columns.name: open_price
columns.desc: Opening price for the trading day - used for gap analysis and overnight performance

columns.name: high_price
columns.desc: Highest price during the trading day - used for range and volatility analysis

columns.name: low_price
columns.desc: Lowest price during the trading day - used for range and volatility analysis

columns.name: close_price
columns.desc: Closing price (most commonly used for analysis) - primary price for calculations

columns.name: volume
columns.desc: Trading volume for the day - used for liquidity analysis and volume indicators

columns.name: adjusted_close
columns.desc: Close price adjusted for splits and dividends - used for long-term performance analysis

business_rules: One record per symbol per trading day
Weekends and holidays have no records (market closed)
Splits and dividends reflected in adjusted_close column
Data updated daily after market close
common_queries: Recent prices: SELECT TOP 30 * FROM stock_prices WHERE symbol = 'AAPL' ORDER BY price_date DESC
Price range: SELECT * FROM stock_prices WHERE symbol = 'MSFT' AND price_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY price_date
Daily change: SELECT close_price - open_price as daily_change, ((close_price - open_price) / open_price) * 100 as daily_percent FROM stock_prices WHERE symbol = 'GOOGL' ORDER BY price_date DESC
Volume analysis: SELECT AVG(volume) as avg_volume, MAX(volume) as max_volume FROM stock_prices WHERE symbol = 'TSLA' AND price_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE())
Moving averages: SELECT AVG(close_price) FROM stock_prices WHERE symbol = 'AAPL' AND price_date >= DATEADD(day, -50, GETDATE())

financial_ratios.description: Key financial metrics and ratios for fundamental analysis
financial_ratios.usage_notes: Updated quarterly with earnings reports. Essential for valuation analysis and financial health assessment.

columns.name: symbol
columns.desc: Stock ticker symbol (foreign key references stocks.symbol)

columns.name: report_date
columns.desc: Date of the financial report (quarterly earnings)

columns.name: pe_ratio
columns.desc: Price to earnings ratio - valuation metric (lower can indicate undervalued)

columns.name: peg_ratio
columns.desc: Price/earnings to growth ratio - accounts for growth rate

columns.name: price_to_book
columns.desc: Market price relative to book value per share

columns.name: dividend_yield
columns.desc: Annual dividend as percentage of stock price

columns.name: eps
columns.desc: Earnings per share - profitability metric

columns.name: revenue_growth
columns.desc: Revenue growth rate percentage (year-over-year)

columns.name: profit_margin
columns.desc: Net profit margin percentage - profitability efficiency

columns.name: debt_to_equity
columns.desc: Debt to equity ratio - financial leverage measure

columns.name: current_ratio
columns.desc: Current assets to current liabilities - liquidity measure

columns.name: return_on_equity
columns.desc: ROE - profitability relative to shareholder equity

columns.name: beta
columns.desc: Beta coefficient - volatility relative to overall market

business_rules: Data updated quarterly after earnings releases
Most recent quarter should be used for analysis
Historical data available for trend analysis
Missing values indicate data not available or not applicable
common_queries: Latest metrics: SELECT TOP 1 * FROM financial_ratios WHERE symbol = 'AAPL' ORDER BY report_date DESC
Value stocks: SELECT * FROM financial_ratios WHERE pe_ratio < 15 AND debt_to_equity < 1.0 ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
High growth: SELECT * FROM financial_ratios WHERE revenue_growth > 20 AND peg_ratio < 1.5
Dividend stocks: SELECT * FROM financial_ratios WHERE dividend_yield > 3.0 AND profit_margin > 10 ORDER BY dividend_yield DESC

user_portfolios.description: User investment portfolios for tracking and analysis
user_portfolios.usage_notes: Each user can have multiple portfolios for different investment strategies or goals.

columns.name: portfolio_id
columns.desc: Unique portfolio identifier (primary key)

columns.name: user_id
columns.desc: User account identifier (foreign key to users table)

columns.name: portfolio_name
columns.desc: User-defined name for the portfolio

columns.name: portfolio_type
columns.desc: Portfolio strategy: 'growth', 'income', 'balanced', 'speculative'

columns.name: initial_capital
columns.desc: Starting investment amount

columns.name: created_at
columns.desc: Portfolio creation date

columns.name: last_updated
columns.desc: Last modification date

business_rules: Each user can create multiple portfolios
Portfolio names must be unique per user
Initial capital cannot be negative
common_queries: User portfolios: SELECT * FROM user_portfolios WHERE user_id = 'user123'
Portfolio summary: SELECT portfolio_name, initial_capital, created_at FROM user_portfolios WHERE portfolio_id = 'PORT_1234'

portfolio_holdings.usage_notes: Core table for portfolio analysis and performance tracking. Links portfolios to individual stocks.

columns.name: holding_id
columns.desc: Unique holding identifier (primary key)

columns.name: portfolio_id
columns.desc: Portfolio identifier (foreign key to user_portfolios)

columns.name: symbol
columns.desc: Stock ticker symbol (foreign key to stocks.symbol)

columns.name: shares
columns.desc: Number of shares held (can be fractional for some securities)

columns.name: average_cost
columns.desc: Average purchase price per share (updated on each buy)

columns.name: purchase_date
columns.desc: Date shares were acquired

columns.name: last_updated
columns.desc: Last time this holding was modified

business_rules: Multiple holdings of same symbol are consolidated into single record
Average cost updated using weighted average method
Shares cannot be negative (short selling not supported)
common_queries: Portfolio holdings: SELECT ph.symbol, ph.shares, ph.average_cost, s.company_name FROM portfolio_holdings ph JOIN stocks s ON ph.symbol = s.symbol WHERE ph.portfolio_id = 'PORT_1234'

Portfolio value: SELECT SUM(ph.shares * sp.close_price) as total_value FROM portfolio_holdings ph JOIN stock_prices sp ON ph.symbol = sp.symbol WHERE ph.portfolio_id = 'PORT_1234' AND sp.price_date = (SELECT MAX(price_date) FROM stock_prices)
Concentration risk: SELECT symbol, SUM(shares * average_cost) as total_cost FROM portfolio_holdings WHERE portfolio_id = 'PORT_1234' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY total_cost DESC

market_indices.description: Major market index data for benchmark comparison
market_indices.usage_notes: Contains daily values for major indices like S&P 500, DOW, NASDAQ for performance comparison.

columns.name: index_name
columns.desc: Index identifier ('S&P_500', 'DOW_JONES', 'NASDAQ', 'RUSSELL_2000')

columns.name: price_date
columns.desc: Date of index value

columns.name: index_value
columns.desc: Closing value of the index

columns.name: daily_change
columns.desc: Point change from previous day

columns.name: daily_change_percent
columns.desc: Percentage change from previous day

columns.name: volume
columns.desc: Trading volume for the index

business_rules: One record per index per trading day
Data updated daily after market close
Used for benchmark comparison and relative performance analysis
common_queries: Latest indices: SELECT * FROM market_indices WHERE price_date = (SELECT MAX(price_date) FROM market_indices) ORDER BY index_name
Index performance: SELECT index_name, AVG(daily_change_percent) as avg_daily_return FROM market_indices WHERE price_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) GROUP BY index_name

sectors.description: Sector performance data for market analysis
sectors.usage_notes: Daily sector performance data for sector rotation analysis and diversification insights.

columns.name: sector_name
columns.desc: Sector name ('Technology', 'Healthcare', 'Finance', etc.)

columns.name: performance_date
columns.desc: Date of sector performance data

columns.name: daily_return_percent
columns.desc: Sector performance for the day

columns.name: volume
columns.desc: Total trading volume for sector

columns.name: market_cap_weight
columns.desc: Percentage of total market cap represented by this sector

business_rules: Updated daily with market close
Used for sector rotation strategies
Helps identify market leadership and lagging areas
common_queries: Today's sector performance: SELECT * FROM sectors WHERE performance_date = (SELECT MAX(performance_date) FROM sectors) ORDER BY daily_return_percent DESC
Sector leaders: SELECT TOP 3 sector_name, AVG(daily_return_percent) as avg_return FROM sectors WHERE performance_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()) GROUP BY sector_name ORDER BY avg_return DESC
